text.tspan: SJ HAVE BEEN RELOCATED TO END OF ISLAND
SJ ADDED AT TANK SLAB NEED TO BE AT A MINIMUM
OF 2' FROM MAN WAY LIDS TO AVOID SAW-CUTS IN
DIAGONAL CUTS HAVE BEEN ADDED TO ELIMINATE
AS MANY DEAD-END SAW-CUTS AS POSSIBLE
WHERE SAW CUT MEET CURB LINE TOOLED JOINTS
OR SAW-CUTS NEED TO CARRY THROUGH TO
- FIRE EXTINGUISHER CABINET TO BE, BROOKS MODEL # MARK II,
CABINET WITH CLEAR COVER (OR EQUAL) - FIRE EXTINGUISHER
NEW HEAVY DUTY ASPHALT: SEE CIVIL
AND ADD DO NOT ENTER SIGN.
PAINTED TRAFFIC CONTROL STRIPING - SEE DETAIL
CONTROL JOINT AT END OF ISLANDS - SEE 18 / AG-6
NEW "IN CASE OF FIRE OR SPILL" SIGNAGE ON FOUR SIDES - SEE AG-2, 11/AG-6
NEW "NO SMOKING / STOP ENGINE" SIGNAGE ON TWO SIDES- SEE AG-2, 11/AG-6
NEW SPLICE BOX BY GC OR UTILITY CO.
NEW ELECTRICAL CONDUIT BY GC OR UTILITY CO.
NEW TMS ADDITIVE CABINET - SEE 5 / AG-6
NEW VST GREEN MACHINE - SEE 10 / AG-6
NEW OVERFILL ALARM ON PEDESTAL - SEE 15 / AG-6
NEW LANDSCAPING - TO MATCH EXISTING ON SITE WHERE DISTURBED
NEW COMMUNICATION CONDUIT PULL BOX - GC TO VERIFY IN FIELD OR INSTALL NEW ONE
EXISTING COMMUNICATION CONDUIT TO WAREHOUSE - GC TO VERIFY IN FIELD
NEW COMMUNICATION CONDUIT TO CONTROLLER ENCLOSURE - BY GC OR UTILITY CO.
CONSTRUCTION SITE DURING ALL PHASES OF CONSTRUCTION.
ADJACENT PAVEMENT. DOWEL CONCRETE SURFACES WITH #4 DOWELS AT 18" OC.
LOCATED IN THE UNDER CANOPY SLAB.
SEE LANDSCAPE DRAWINGS FOR PLANTING AND IRRIGATION INFORMATION.
SEE ELECTRICAL DRAWINGS FOR SITE ELECTRICAL.
SIGNS IDENTIFYING THE EMERGENCY SHUT-OFF SWITCH SHALL BE LABELED EMERGENCY SHUTOFF.
